csv_scope_of_work: This RFP is for engaging a qualified engineering consulting firm to provide professional engineering design services for the 202526 Bridge Preventative Maintenance Program of the City of Santa Clarita. The program is federally funded through Caltrans and requires compliance with federal, state, and local regulations. The objective of this RFP is to retain a qualified engineering consulting firm to provide professional engineering design services for the Citys 202526 Bridge Preventative Maintenance Program. The 202526 Bridge Preventative Maintenance Program is funded through federal bridge funding administered by Caltrans
